overview: Outside St John's Gate you and John Heminges went over Edmund Tilney's clean signature on fifty leaves of Romeo and Juliet, the seven-shilling fee, your sting at his slight, and his warning to let Richard II alone — confirming Garnish's three leaves stay locked in the chest before you walked on to the Bell.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Still stung by Tilney's dismissal of the lovers' play and alert to his parting warning on Richard II.

parties.name: John Heminges
parties.context: Called a clean licence the only kind the company can afford and confirmed Garnish's three leaves stay locked.

parties.name: Edmund Tilney
parties.context: Signed all fifty leaves without a cut and warned to let the other play keep its bounds.

parties.name: Abel Garnish
parties.context: Keeps the three cut leaves of Richard II locked in the chest.

parties.name: Thomas Hobbins
parties.context: Carrier at the Bell in Carter Lane where William walks next.

parties.name: Gilbert Shakespeare
parties.context: May already have reached Hobbins's bag at the Bell.
